content.short: Coin98 Super Wallet is a non-custodial multi-chain wallet with DEX, bridge, dApp browser, and TON support.
content.description: Coin98 Super Wallet is a non-custodial multi-chain wallet for storing tokens, NFTs, and decentralized identities. Coin98 documentation describes support for more than 100 blockchains, including The Open Network, plus built-in DEX access, cross-chain bridging, a dApp browser, wallet approvals, and multi-sender tools. For TON users, it is a broader multi-chain wallet option rather than a TON-only wallet. Coin98 Super Wallet works as an access point for holding assets, signing transactions, connecting to apps, and moving funds across supported networks.
